answer: Shared hardware gives sybil farms away when the ledger fires a surprise signal: at a random second, every key must solve a 3-second memory-hard puzzle at once. Replies that slow down together reveal one rig, and its keys are priced as a group, where key number k bonds 30×k² POA. A rig of ten must lock 11,550, and a rig of 1,000 over 10 billion, while a whole epoch's emission is only about 0.4M. Keys that stay unlinked for 30 epochs earn ivory status and half their bond back; slashed bonds build a dune fund that pays anyone proving a link. Weakness: renting a cloud box per clone.
